incident: `package.json` was judged by PATH under the claim that a dependency manifest has no authority beyond which versions install. `ci.yml` falsifies it: `format:check`, `lint`, `typecheck`, `test` and `build` are all `package.json` scripts. One commit on a bot branch keeps `user.login == dependabot[bot]`, so only the CONTENT betrays it. Exit 0 before 2026-09-23.
